name: qwen
label: Qwen
key_hint: An API key from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Singapore region — a key works only in the region that issued it.
note: Alibaba now gives each workspace its own address, https://<workspace id>.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. The shared one filled in here still answers.

name: zai
label: Z.ai GLM
note: On the GLM Coding Plan the address is https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4.

name: openrouter
label: OpenRouter
note: OpenRouter names models vendor/model, and these prefixes send those vendors' models here. Two providers cannot share a prefix, so trim the list if another one should get some of them.

name: together
label: Together AI
note: Together names models organization/model. openai/, qwen/ and moonshotai/ are left out because OpenRouter uses them too; add them if Together should get those.

name: azure
label: Azure OpenAI
key_hint: The API key of your Azure OpenAI resource.
note: Put your resource's name in the address. Azure routes by deployment name, so name deployments azure-… (or change the prefix to match yours): a deployment called gpt-4o would go to OpenAI instead.

name: ollama
label: Ollama
key_hint: Ollama needs no key; any placeholder does.
note: Ollama names models name:tag. Set the prefixes to the models you pull. From Docker Compose, the gateway reaches Ollama on the host at http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1.

name: vllm
label: vLLM
key_hint: The --api-key vLLM was started with, or any placeholder if it has none.
note: Start vLLM with --served-model-name vllm/<name>, or set the prefixes to the names it serves.
